weeks.rationale: Build week, three weeks out from the 14 Nov doubles race. Threshold Tuesday steps back to 32 min at a centred 4:10-4:12/km after 10-20's reps drifted to 183-188 bpm at 4:07-4:09. Wednesday's hinge session uses the loads actually lifted (trap-bar 150 kg). Saturday is the full doubles rehearsal owed from 10-23: 8 race-pace km, each out of a hard station burst. weeks.methodology: Polarized: threshold and the rehearsal are the only hard running, and everything else is easy under the 145 bpm talk-test ceiling. Threshold is held at a fixed pace and dosed for steadiness rather than duration, because drift shows the dose has reached its limit. Specificity rises: the rehearsal copies the doubles demand of full running volume with roughly half the station work in short bursts. Heavy strength progresses from recorded sets, not stale config, and stays morning-only, about 24 h after threshold.
